1.name: Dragon Ancestor & Draconic Resilience (Draconic Bloodline)
1.description: Speak Draconic & pick an elemental Dragon Ancestor; +1 HP per Sorcerer level and base AC = 13 + DEX modifier when unarmored.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.description: Add CHA modifier to one damage roll of spells matching your Draconic element, and spend 1 SP for 1 hour Damage Resistance.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.description: Bonus Action manifests dragon wings granting a Fly Speed equal to your current walking speed.

18.name: Draconic Presence
18.description: Spend 5 SP as an Action for a 60-ft aura of awe or fear for 1 minute.

1.name: Wild Magic Surge & Tides of Chaos
1.description: Spontaneous d20 chaos triggers Wild Magic Surges after leveled spells; gain Advantage on one attack, check, or save (recharged on Surge or Long Rest).

6.name: Bend Luck
6.description: Reaction spends 2 SP to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's attack, check, or save.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
14.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and use either number.

18.name: Spell Bombardment
18.description: When rolling the maximum value on a spell damage die, roll it again and add the roll (1/turn).

1.name: Divine Magic & Favored by the Gods
1.description: Access the full Cleric spell list as Sorcerer spells (+alignment spell); add +2d4 to a failed save or missed attack (1/Short or Long Rest).

6.name: Empowered Healing
6.description: Spend 1 SP to reroll any number of healing dice for yourself or an ally within 5 ft.

14.name: Otherworldly Wings
14.description: Bonus Action manifests spectral wings granting a 30-ft Fly Speed.

18.name: Unearthly Recovery
18.description: Bonus Action regains up to half your max HP when below half HP (1/Long Rest).

1.name: Eyes of the Dark & Strength of the Grave
1.description: 120-ft Darkvision (+Darkness at L3 see-through for 2 SP); CHA save prevents dropping to 0 HP (drops to 1 HP, 1/Long Rest).

6.name: Hound of Ill Omen
6.description: Bonus Action spends 3 SP to summon a spectral Hound imposing Disadvantage on the target's saves vs your spells.

14.name: Shadow Walk
14.description: Bonus Action teleports 120 ft from dim light/darkness to another dim light/darkness space.

18.name: Umbral Form
18.description: Spend 6 SP as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: pass through objects/creatures and Resistance to all damage except Force/Radiant.

1.name: Wind Speaker & Tempestuous Magic
1.description: Speak Primordial; Bonus Action flies 10 ft without Opportunity Attacks before or after casting a 1st+ level spell.

6.name: Heart of the Storm & Storm Guide
6.description: Resistance to Lightning & Thunder; casting Lightning/Thunder spells erupts 10-ft AoE dealing half Sorcerer level damage.

14.name: Storm's Fury
14.description: Reaction deals Sorcerer level Lightning damage and pushes melee attackers 20 ft (STR save).

18.name: Wind Soul
18.description: Immunity to Lightning and Thunder damage, 60-ft Fly Speed, and share 30-ft flight with allies 1/Short Rest.

1.name: Telepathic Speech & Psionic Spells
1.description: Link telepathically within 30 ft up to 1 mile; permanently add Psionic Spells (Mind Sliver + domain spells) swappable by school.

6.name: Psionic Sorcery & Psychic Defenses
6.description: Cast Psionic Spells spending SP equal to spell level without V/S components; Resistance to Psychic + Adv vs Charmed/Frightened.

14.name: Revelation in Flesh
14.description: Spend 1+ SP as a Bonus Action for 10 min of flight, see invisibility, 60-ft swim speed, or squeezing through 1-inch spaces.

18.name: Warping Implosion
18.description: Teleport 120 ft leaving a 30-ft gravity sphere pulling foes and dealing 3d10 Force damage (1/Long Rest or 5 SP).

1.name: Clockwork Magic & Restore Balance
1.description: Add Clockwork Spells (swappable with Abjuration/Transmutation); Reaction cancels Advantage or Disadvantage within 60 ft (PB/Long Rest).

6.name: Bastion of Law
6.description: Action spends 1–5 SP creating an arcane ward of d8 damage-shield dice on a creature until Long Rest.

14.name: Trance of Order
14.description: Bonus Action spends 5 SP for 1 minute: attacks against you can't have Adv and d20 attacks/checks/saves treat <= 9 as 10.

18.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
18.description: Action restores up to 100 HP across creatures in a 30-ft cube, repairs objects, and ends <= 6th level spells (1/Long Rest or 7 SP).

1.name: Lunar Embodiment & Moon Fire
1.description: Attune to Full/New/Crescent Moon phases unlocking bonus Lunar Spells and Sacred Flame hitting adjacent creatures.

6.name: Lunar Boons & Waxing and Waning
6.description: Reduce Metamagic cost by 1 SP on Lunar Phase spells (PB/Long Rest); spend 1 SP to switch Lunar Phases as a Bonus Action.

14.name: Lunar Empowerment
14.description: Gain phase passives (Full: Adv on Investigation/Perception; New: Adv on Stealth + dim light; Crescent: Radiant/Necrotic Resistance).

18.name: Lunar Phenomenon
18.description: Bonus Action phase shift unleashes lunar bursts (blind enemies + heal ally / Necrotic pulse + Invisibility / teleport) 1/Long Rest or 5 SP.
